text:
sam: Heads up — main CI is red after the merge at ~12:34 UTC. Integration scheduler tests are failing consistently in job ci/integ-976. Can someone help bisect? First seen on 1948005500.

ci-bot: Job ci/integ-976 failed on step 'scheduler_integration_test' (exit code 1). Log: https://ci/integ-976

olivia: thx for ping. can you paste the failing test name + short log?

sam: failing test is TestSchedulerRateLimit.test_backpressure. log snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 42 but got 0
  File "scheduler_test.py", line 214, in test_backpressure
    assert counter == 42
```
Also flaky? no — consistently failing on rerun.

dinesh: suspect merge of #4593 (k8s pod shutdown) — that change touched cache eviction. last-green on main was 1947992000 (before the merge).

taylor: i'll take point. running git bisect locally now against main. need the last-green commit hash — can you confirm? @dinesh said 1947992000 but need commit sha.

sam: last green commit sha is a7c3f9b (from CI run 1947992000).

taylor: thanks. running `git bisect start` + test harness. will push updates in ~20m.

dinesh: if bisect points to runtime/kube, ping me for quick revert. also, can someone rerun the failing job with `--serialize-logs`? helps narrow flakes.

olivia: re-run queued: @ci-bot can you rerun ci/integ-976 with serialize logs flag?

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: ci/integ-976-rerun-1 by olivia. link: https://ci/integ-976/rerun/1

taylor: bisect iteration 5/12 — narrowed to commits between a7c3f9b..f3d2b11. reproducing locally; failing when kube drain is simulated. suspect #4593 still.

sam: appreciate it. if taylor confirms, we should cut a rollback PR for #4593 and gate non-blocking rollout.

revert-bot: Auto-check: PR #4593 has failing e2e in staging, cannot auto-rollback without owner approval.

taylor: confirmed culprit commit f3d2b11. creating draft revert now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4701 (WIP). tagging @dinesh for review.

dinesh: ack — will review and approve ASAP. also adding a test to exercise drain timing.

sam: great. olivia please monitor CI and keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
